title: Isomorphisms of coherent formal modules are detected on an open cover
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent ideal, $X=\bigcup_{j\in J}U_j$ an open covering, and $\alpha:(\mathcal F_n)\to(\mathcal G_n)$ a morphism in $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. If every component $\alpha_n|_{U_j}:\mathcal F_n|_{U_j}\to\mathcal G_n|_{U_j}$ is an isomorphism for every $j,n$, then $\alpha$ is an isomorphism in $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 087X (lemma-inverse-systems-abelian), proof after the affine construction: a morphism whose components are isomorphisms is an isomorphism; exactness is checked on an open covering

mathlib_searches.query: a morphism of inverse systems of coherent sheaves is an isomorphism when all components are isomorphisms on an open cover
mathlib_searches.results: CategoryTheory.Functor.mapIso, AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.OpenCover.mapIso (open-cover sheaf data only); no category Coh(X,I)

mathlib_searches.query: isomorphism of coherent formal modules detected after restriction to an open covering
mathlib_searches.results: Presieve.IsSheafFor, Sheaf.IsIso_of_components, CategoryTheory.IsIso.of_iso; no formal-module locality theorem
no category of coherent formal modules and no corresponding locality theorem; only generic IsIso transport and sheaf cover APIs
